confidence_notes: Recent local cost-of-living aggregates support the meal, coffee and beer estimates, though some city price data has few contributors. Cocktail and wine prices vary by venue, so they are bounded estimates informed by local beer prices and tourist-bar levels. Accommodation estimates are holistic; seasonal and lakefront premiums can widen the range.
comparable_city_reasoning: Udaipur’s visitor demand supports three-star rates above Varanasi, Jaisalmer and Kolkata, near but slightly below Chennai. Basic rooms, private hostel rooms and dorms remain within the supplied comparison ranges, with Udaipur above Jaisalmer’s lowest prices.
